name: uk-police-crime-mcp-server
description: Search UK street crime, outcomes, stop and search, and neighbourhood teams (Scotland: BTP only).

interface.shortDescription: Search UK street crime, outcomes, stop and search, and neighbourhood teams (Scotland: BTP only).
interface.longDescription: Search the monthly records data.police.uk publishes: street-level crimes with their latest police outcome, what police resolved in an area each month, and stop and search with ethnicity, legislation, object of search and outcome. Search a 1-mile point radius, a polygon, a snapped map point, a police neighbourhood, or a whole force, and follow a crime's full outcome history by its persistent id. Resolve a coordinate to its force and neighbourhood policing team, with the team's public contact channels, current priorities, upcoming events and boundary. Coverage is the territorial forces of England and Wales and the Police Service of Northern Ireland, plus British Transport Police, the only coverage of Scotland. Every location is an anonymised map point covering at least eight addresses, and each result says when a force has not published. No API key required.
